name: airpods-mcp
description: MCP-AQL adapter for AirPods Pro head-tracking on macOS. Bottom layer is a Swift .app bundle wrapping CMHeadphoneMotionManager (.app required for TCC); top layer is this Node MCP server which speaks stdio MCP and rebroadcasts the pose stream as a HUD WebSocket.

target.axis_convention: CMHMM: positive yaw=head turned LEFT, positive pitch=head tilted UP
target.audio_session_note: Stream pauses silently when no audio is routed through AirPods. Run a continuous silent-WAV loop alongside the adapter.

read.name: list_devices
read.description: Status of the underlying motion source (whether the Swift .app is connected and streaming poses).

read.name: is_streaming
read.description: Whether pose samples are currently arriving. Returns connected flag and ms since last sample. If audio session is inactive, this will report stale.

read.name: get_pose
read.description: Latest pose sample. Returns quaternion, euler (yaw/pitch/roll in radians), rotation rate, and capture timestamp.

read.name: wait_for_pose
read.description: Block until the next pose sample arrives, then return it. Useful for sample-aligned reads.

read.name: get_recent_poses
read.description: Last N pose samples from the in-memory ring buffer (default capacity 100).

read.name: get_calibration
read.description: Returns the persisted calibration capture (anchor points) plus the currently-applied yaw/pitch offsets. The offsets are what consumers should add to raw pose samples to align with the calibration's reference frame.

read.name: get_hud_url
read.description: Return the URL of the live HUD (HTTP + WebSocket). Open in a browser or connect via WS for a low-latency pose stream.

read.name: get_provenance
read.description: Discovery and generation provenance for this adapter (how it was built, what it wraps).

read.name: is_sidecar_running
read.description: Check whether a sample sidecar is currently running (reads /tmp/airpods-sidecar.pid and signals 0 to the PID).

create.name: calibrate_point
create.description: Capture the current head pose, average over a window, and add it to calibration as a named anchor (e.g. 'main_center', 'main_top_left'). For 10-point full calibration, call this 10 times with the appropriate ids.

samples.description: Number of pose samples to median over.

update.name: recenter
update.description: Atomic recenter: capture current pose, compute offset against the calibration's main_center anchor, persist offsets, return the new offsets. Idempotent if user pose doesn't change between calls.

reference_id.description: Which calibration anchor to align current pose to.

update.name: set_offset
update.description: Manually set yaw and pitch offsets. Replaces current offsets atomically.

offsetYaw.description: Radians to add to incoming raw yaw to align with calibration frame.

offsetPitch.description: Radians to add to incoming raw pitch to align with calibration frame.

delete.name: clear_offsets
delete.description: Zero the offsets file. Pose samples will then be returned in raw (uncorrected) form to consumers reading offsets-applied data.

execute.name: start_sidecar
execute.description: Spawn the bundled sample sidecar (gaze-driven X-mouse focus + transparent dwell-indicator overlay). The sidecar consumes this adapter's HUD WebSocket. Idempotent — if a sidecar is already running, returns its PID without spawning another.

blob_follow.description: Enable the transparent dwell-indicator overlay window.

mouse_follow.description: Also warp the OS mouse cursor to the gaze point (debug only; hijacks user mouse).
